nature: Presence-background susceptibility ranking (relative index, not a probability). Not a warning system.

iffi_suedtirol.provider: Autonome Provinz Bozen / ISPRA IFFI, WFS geoservices1.civis.bz.it, layer p_bz-Geology:IdroGEO-Landslides-Events-Areas
iffi_suedtirol.license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 (stricter reading; open-data portal record states CC0, see DECISIONS.md)

dem.source: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC collection nasadem (anonymous SAS token), 1 arc-second, EGM96 heights
dem.acquisition_note: SRTM flown on Space Shuttle Endeavour 11-22 February 2000 (USGS EROS page). NASADEM is SRTM-derived; void filling uses other elevation data of unrecorded date and the hosted copy has no source-flag layer.
dem.rule: dem acquisition_end must not be later than the earliest event date of any development dataset; violations fail registry validation

rejected.copernicus_glo30: TanDEM-X data acquired 2011-2015 (Copernicus Data Space page); post-dates Far-Western Nepal events 2002-2011 and cannot be shown to pre-date Gorkha April 2015 per tile.

sensitivity_only.copernicus_glo30: Only for RER2023 (May 2023), as an explicitly labelled sensitivity comparison, never for model selection.

dem.working_crs: local UTM zone of the inventory centroid (Gorkha 44N/45N by tile, Far-Western Nepal 44N, RER2023 32N, Suedtirol 32N)

earthquake_ground_motion.source: USGS ShakeMap grid.xml (PGA), event us20002926 for Gorkha
earthquake_ground_motion.use: exploratory feature set terrain+PGA for earthquake inventories only; primary models use terrain features only
earthquake_ground_motion.caveat: ShakeMap is a modelled estimate (about 1 km), not a measurement

model_b_soil_moisture.source: ERA5-Land soil moisture via Open-Meteo archive API (free non-commercial)

triggers.resolution_caveat: Rain and soil moisture fields have 5-11 km cells and do not distinguish slopes inside one area; only time/event contrasts are informative.

feature_rules.aspect: circular: sin and cos only; angular differences via circular distance

positive_rule.unit: one cell per valid landslide polygon
positive_rule.cell_choice: uniform random (seeded) among cells whose centre lies in the source-area polygon if available, otherwise in the top third by elevation of the polygon cells
positive_rule.exclusion_counting: polygons below the minimum area, invalid geometries and non-landslide process classes are excluded and counted by reason

background_rule.extent: inside the mapping extent, outside obscured areas
background_rule.design: area-uniform random cells (seeded), not matched on terrain

exclusion_buffer_rule.statistic: for each development inventory: 90th percentile of equivalent radius sqrt(area/pi) over valid positive polygons
exclusion_buffer_rule.global_value: maximum over the development inventories, rounded up to the next 10 m, floor 60 m
exclusion_buffer_rule.inputs_allowed: inventory geometry only; no terrain, no model score, no Suedtirol data
exclusion_buffer_rule.frozen_by: Amendment 1 (written after Phase 1 download, before any terrain feature or model)

sampling.ratio_note: Sampling parameter, not a frequency in the landscape. PR-AUC is only reported at this ratio.

splits.primary: leave-one-inventory-out over the development inventories (cross-region), blocks as bootstrap units
splits.secondary: spatial block cross-validation within each inventory, 5 km blocks with 1 km gap
splits.forbidden: random pixel or random polygon splits

null_reference.scheme: permutation of presence labels within blocks

metrics.paired_differences: model minus baseline and arm minus arm get their own block-bootstrap interval; better only if the interval excludes zero, otherwise 'no established benefit'
metrics.dominance_check: report without the largest single block or cluster when it holds more than 20 percent of positives

baselines.random: AUC 0.5 reference plus the permutation null
baselines.simple_logistic: logistic regression on slope_deg, elevation_m, profile_curvature, plan_curvature
baselines.distance_to_known_landslide: negative distance to the nearest other known landslide polygon; baseline for the neighbourhood test only
baselines.elsus_v2: external European reference raster; optional, not registered as available (access untested)

models.gradient_boosting_library: scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting unless xgboost/lightgbm is added with justification in requirements-lock.txt
models.hyperparameter_selection: development folds only, fixed grid recorded in the run configuration

arms.MODEL_D_matched: MODEL_D downsampled to the positive count of MODEL_Q with the same trigger-class composition
arms.details: Amendment required before Phase 6 (hold-out targets and downsampling procedure)

positive_subset.geometry: polygon features only (Events-Areas); identification points, linear events, deep-seated gravitational deformation and geomorphology elements are not used
positive_subset.exclusion_reason: rockfall, collapse, creep and diffuse area classes are not slope-failure processes comparable to the training inventories
positive_subset.temporal_evaluation: none; IFFI Suedtirol has no event date field

expected_counts_at_registration.source: attribute-only WFS query 2026-10-17, no geometry inspected

background.extent: province of Suedtirol (administrative boundary from an open source recorded in DATA_SOURCES.md at Phase 15), no slope or land-cover mask
background.design: area-uniform random cells, seeded, 30 m grid
background.buffer_m: same global value as the development inventories (Amendment 1); never re-derived from Suedtirol
background.known_limitation: IFFI is not a complete systematic map: background cells may contain undocumented landslides, so AUC measures separation of documented landslides from background, not completeness

secondary_variant.name: steep_only
secondary_variant.status: pre-registered, counted as a second comparison, not the headline

south_tyrol_blind_test.background_redraws: 5 additional seeded redraws, reported as spread; the first draw is the headline
south_tyrol_blind_test.metrics: primary roc_auc with 5 km block bootstrap; also average precision at ratio 1:1, continuous Boyce index, recall in top 20 percent area
south_tyrol_blind_test.execution: exactly once, by the Phase 15 script, only after explicit written approval of the user and a frozen model manifest
south_tyrol_blind_test.after_execution: Suedtirol data count as seen; further analyses are exploratory and labelled so

gates.phase1: licences recorded from the original record; mapping extent available for each development inventory
gates.phase2: CRS, circular aspect and no-leakage tests pass and each was shown to fail on an injected bug
gates.phase3: buffer and minimum-separation tests pass; every positive/background draw reproducible from the seed
gates.phase4: model beats slope_only on the primary leave-one-inventory-out design: lower bound of the 95 percent paired block-bootstrap interval of the AUC difference is above 0; otherwise cause analysis instead of extension
gates.phase5: independent units and intervals are reported for every headline number

phase7_model_b.event_independence: day-resolved date and at least 7 days or at least 100 km apart
phase7_model_b.note: Chosen before seeing any data as a design decision, not derived. Pilot inventories (Gorkha, RER2023: one event each; Far-Western Nepal: year resolution) are not expected to pass; if the gate fails Model B is dropped.

open_items.resolved_by: Amendment 1 after Phase 1 download, before terrain and models
built-in browser (ScienceBase blocks scripts); no workaround
